prompt: A fruit seller in Quito said me a monkey had stolen his oranges.
answer: A fruit seller in Quito told me a monkey had stolen his oranges.
accepted_answers: A fruit seller in Quito told me a monkey had stolen his oranges.
A fruit seller in Quito told me that a monkey had stolen his oranges.
A fruit seller in Quito said to me that a monkey had stolen his oranges.
A fruit seller in Quito said to me a monkey had stolen his oranges.
explanation_ru: После глагола say нельзя сразу ставить дополнение без предлога to; при указании собеседника нужен глагол tell (told me). Типичная ошибка — калька «сказал мне» как said me.

prompt: The park gate stayed open. Our officer says nobody ___ it on weekdays.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол says стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому сдвиг времён для регулярного действия не нужен (locks). Частая ошибка — автоматически ставить Past Simple (locked).

prompt: On a trail in Nepal, our guide told us, "Fog usually comes here after lunch, so you should turn back before three." Back at the hostel later, which report is correct?
options: Our guide warned us that fog usually came here after lunch, so we should turn back before three.
Our guide warned us that fog usually came there after lunch, so we had to turn back before three.
Our guide warned us that fog usually came there after lunch, so we should turn back before three.
Our guide warned us that fog usually came there after lunch, so you should turn back before three.
explanation_ru: При передаче слов в хостеле here меняется на there, you — на we, а модальный глагол should сохраняется без изменений. Ошибки — оставлять here/you или заменять should на had to.

prompt: At the campsite in Canada, a park guard warned the campers to not leave food outside their tents because of bears.
answer: At the campsite in Canada, a park guard warned the campers not to leave food outside their tents because of bears.
accepted_answers: At the campsite in Canada, a park guard warned the campers not to leave food outside their tents because of bears.
explanation_ru: В отрицательном инфинитиве частица not всегда стоит перед to (not to leave). Порядок слов to not — частая ошибка в косвенных предупреждениях и приказах.

prompt: In our garden in Japan, Grandmother told us that the old cherry tree had lost its biggest branch the night before. → Grandmother told us, "The old cherry tree …
answer: Grandmother told us, "The old cherry tree lost its biggest branch last night."
accepted_answers: Grandmother told us, "The old cherry tree lost its biggest branch last night."
Grandmother told us, 'The old cherry tree lost its biggest branch last night.'
explanation_ru: При переводе обратно в прямую речь Past Perfect (had lost) с указанием на прошлое время возвращается в Past Simple (lost), а the night before — в last night.

prompt: Before sunset in Morocco, our guide explained that the stars are brightest in the desert because there is no city light.
answer: Before sunset in Morocco, our guide explained that the stars are brightest in the desert because there is no city light.
accepted_answers: Before sunset in Morocco, our guide explained that the stars are brightest in the desert because there is no city light.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: постоянный факт и общая истина сохраняют Present Simple даже после вводного глагола в прошедшем времени.

prompt: Zanele wrote to her group last Tuesday that she would bring the project tomorrow. The lab printer was broken, so she never came.
answer: Zanele wrote to her group last Tuesday that she would bring the project the next day. The lab printer was broken, so she never came.
accepted_answers: Zanele wrote to her group last Tuesday that she would bring the project the next day. The lab printer was broken, so she never came.
Zanele wrote to her group last Tuesday that she would bring the project the following day. The lab printer was broken, so she never came.
Zanele wrote to her group last Tuesday that she would bring the project the day after. The lab printer was broken, so she never came.
explanation_ru: Переписка была в прошлый вторник и день сдачи уже прошёл, поэтому tomorrow нужно заменить на the next day или the following day. Оставлять tomorrow без сдвига — типичная ошибка.

prompt: Jonas heard in Vienna that the physics teacher was leaving. Everyone at the café wondered ___.
explanation_ru: После глагола wonder общий вопрос вводится союзом if и строится с прямым порядком слов (подлежащее перед глаголом). Типичные ошибки — пропустить if, оставить инверсию или поставить that.

prompt: In Montreal, Émilie told Mum, "I have found my best friend at college." → In Montreal, Émilie told Mum …
answer: In Montreal, Émilie told Mum she had found her best friend at college.
accepted_answers: In Montreal, Émilie told Mum she had found her best friend at college.
In Montreal, Émilie told Mum that she had found her best friend at college.
In Montreal, Émilie told Mum she'd found her best friend at college.
In Montreal, Émilie told Mum that she'd found her best friend at college.
explanation_ru: В косвенной речи Present Perfect (have found) сдвигается в Past Perfect (had found), а местоимения I и my меняются на she и her.

prompt: Stefan had too many emails. He promised his team he ___ the report.
explanation_ru: После вводного глагола promised в прошедшем времени will переходит в would (would send). Оставлять will без сдвига — частая ошибка.

prompt: Herr Braun asked the Berlin drivers check their vans before the cold trip.
answer: Herr Braun asked the Berlin drivers to check their vans before the cold trip.
accepted_answers: Herr Braun asked the Berlin drivers to check their vans before the cold trip.
explanation_ru: В косвенной просьбе после ask + дополнение обязателен инфинитив с частицей to (asked the drivers to check). Пропуск to — частая ошибка.

prompt: In Accra, Efua asked a man, "Did you lose your wallet?" Which report fits?
options: Efua asked the man if did he lose his wallet.
Efua asked the man had he lost his wallet.
Efua asked the man if he loses his wallet.
Efua asked the man if he had lost his wallet.
explanation_ru: Общий вопрос в косвенной речи вводится союзом if, сохраняет прямой порядок слов без did и сдвигает Past Simple в Past Perfect (had lost).

prompt: Sigrid heard in Reykjavik that a local firm was hiring five new writers. She immediately suggested ___ our CVs together before the weekend.
explanation_ru: После глагола suggest нужен герундий (-ing) или придаточное с that, но не инфинитив с to. Типичные ошибки — suggest to send и suggest us to send.

prompt: Before my interview in Porto, I asked Inês when the job office opened on weekdays. → I asked Inês, "When …
answer: I asked Inês, "When does the job office open on weekdays?"
accepted_answers: I asked Inês, "When does the job office open on weekdays?"
I asked Inês, 'When does the job office open on weekdays?'
explanation_ru: При возврате косвенного вопроса о регулярном расписании в прямую речь восстанавливается вспомогательный глагол does (When does the job office open?) и ставится вопросительный знак.

prompt: Sanne from the Utrecht clothes shop apologised to send me the wrong parcel number and promised a quick reply.
answer: Sanne from the Utrecht clothes shop apologised for sending me the wrong parcel number and promised a quick reply.
accepted_answers: Sanne from the Utrecht clothes shop apologised for sending me the wrong parcel number and promised a quick reply.
Sanne from the Utrecht clothes shop apologised for having sent me the wrong parcel number and promised a quick reply.
explanation_ru: Глагол apologise требует предлога for и герундия (apologised for sending), а не инфинитива с to. Форма apologise to do — частая ошибка.

prompt: The supermarket shelves in Gdańsk were half empty. Still, Ola's manager strongly denied ___ the shop during August.
explanation_ru: После глагола deny употребляется герундий без предлога (denied closing). Частые ошибки — ставить инфинитив с to или лишний предлог of.

prompt: Near the port in Turku, Aino asked when would the ferry leave.
answer: Near the port in Turku, Aino asked when the ferry would leave.
accepted_answers: Near the port in Turku, Aino asked when the ferry would leave.
explanation_ru: В косвенном вопросе нужен прямой порядок слов: подлежащее (the ferry) ставится перед глаголом (would leave). Инверсия when would the ferry — типичная ошибка.

prompt: At Faro airport, Rui heard an officer announce, "We must cancel all island flights today." Later that week, which report fits?
options: Rui heard an officer announce that they must cancel all island flights today.
Rui heard an officer announce that they had to cancel all island flights that day.
Rui heard an officer announce that we had to cancel all island flights that day.
Rui heard an officer announce that they had to cancel all island flights today.
explanation_ru: При передаче объявления позже we меняется на they, must — на had to, а today — на that day. Ошибки — оставлять must, we или today без изменений.

prompt: Everyone at our Cusco hostel laughed back in June. Leo told us he had missed his bus and slept on a bench two days ago.
answer: Everyone at our Cusco hostel laughed back in June. Leo told us he had missed his bus and slept on a bench two days before.
accepted_answers: Everyone at our Cusco hostel laughed back in June. Leo told us he had missed his bus and slept on a bench two days before.
Everyone at our Cusco hostel laughed back in June. Leo told us he had missed his bus and slept on a bench two days earlier.
explanation_ru: Разговор состоялся ещё в июне, поэтому слово ago в косвенной речи нужно заменить на before или earlier (two days before). Оставлять ago — типичная ошибка.

prompt: On our trip to Poland last May, two waiters whispered to me, "The new pool won't open this summer." → Two waiters whispered to me …
answer: Two waiters whispered to me that the new pool wouldn't open that summer.
accepted_answers: Two waiters whispered to me that the new pool wouldn't open that summer.
Two waiters whispered to me the new pool wouldn't open that summer.
Two waiters whispered to me that the new pool would not open that summer.
Two waiters whispered to me the new pool would not open that summer.
explanation_ru: В косвенной речи won't сдвигается в wouldn't (would not), а this summer при рассказе о прошлогодней поездке меняется на that summer.

prompt: A passenger missed his plane from Nairobi while looking for a drink. A flight attendant joked he wouldn't have missed it if he ___ mango juice.
explanation_ru: Условные предложения третьего типа в косвенной речи не меняются: в части с if остаётся Past Perfect (hadn't bought). Типичные ошибки — ставить would после if или использовать Past Simple.

prompt: In Vietnam, the owner's daughter told us the beach was five minutes away. → The owner's daughter told us, "The beach …
answer: The owner's daughter told us, "The beach is five minutes away."
accepted_answers: The owner's daughter told us, "The beach is five minutes away."
The owner's daughter told us, 'The beach is five minutes away.'
explanation_ru: При переводе обратно в прямую речь форма прошедшего времени was возвращается в настоящее время is, так как речь идёт о расположении пляжа.

prompt: We waited at the night bus station in Mexico City. A tired clerk finally ___ me that platform three was open.
explanation_ru: Только глагол tell ставится напрямую перед личным местоимением без предлога (told me). Глаголы say, explain и announce требуют предлога to перед адресатом.

prompt: On an Indian train platform, two porters warned us, "The train has no food car today." Reported later, which sentence fits?
options: Two porters warned us that the train had no food car that day.
Two porters warned us that the train has no food car that day.
Two porters warned us that the train had no food car today.
Two porters warned to us that the train had no food car that day.
explanation_ru: При передаче слов позже has сдвигается в had, today меняется на that day, а после глагола warn предлог to перед дополнением не нужен.

prompt: Our judo coach in Japan told to the boy to return on Saturday.
answer: Our judo coach in Japan told the boy to return on Saturday.
accepted_answers: Our judo coach in Japan told the boy to return on Saturday.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell перед собеседником предлог to не употребляется: правильно told the boy to return. Лишний предлог to — частая ошибка.

prompt: In Brazil, two volleyball players informed their captain, "The final has been moved to the indoor hall, so we can't play outside." → Two volleyball players informed their captain …
answer: Two volleyball players informed their captain that the final had been moved to the indoor hall, so they couldn't play outside.
accepted_answers: Two volleyball players informed their captain that the final had been moved to the indoor hall, so they couldn't play outside.
Two volleyball players informed their captain the final had been moved to the indoor hall, so they couldn't play outside.
Two volleyball players informed their captain that the final had been moved to the indoor hall, so they could not play outside.
Two volleyball players informed their captain the final had been moved to the indoor hall, so they could not play outside.
explanation_ru: В косвенной речи Present Perfect Passive (has been moved) сдвигается в Past Perfect Passive (had been moved), we меняется на they, а can't — на couldn't.

prompt: The piano concert in Prague had one funny moment. A parent said that the boy helping with the music had skipped two pages, though nobody had noticed.
answer: The piano concert in Prague had one funny moment. A parent said that the boy helping with the music had skipped two pages, though nobody had noticed.
accepted_answers: The piano concert in Prague had one funny moment. A parent said that the boy helping with the music had skipped two pages, though nobody had noticed.
explanation_ru: В этом предложении нет ошибки: события на концерте произошли до разговора, поэтому в обоих придаточных верно использован Past Perfect (had skipped, had noticed).

prompt: Standing at the ticket desk in Seoul, I asked the clerk if did I need my student card for half-price tickets.
answer: Standing at the ticket desk in Seoul, I asked the clerk if I needed my student card for half-price tickets.
accepted_answers: Standing at the ticket desk in Seoul, I asked the clerk if I needed my student card for half-price tickets.
Standing at the ticket desk in Seoul, I asked the clerk whether I needed my student card for half-price tickets.
explanation_ru: В косвенном общем вопросе после if не нужен вспомогательный глагол did и сохраняется прямой порядок слов (if I needed). Конструкция if did I — частая ошибка.
